mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_account ( id, user_id, currency, balance, frozen, margin_used, margin_mode, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{currency}, #{balance}, #{frozen}, #{marginUsed}, #{marginModeCode}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_account SET margin_mode = #{marginModeCode}, mode_changed_at = #{modeChangedAt}, mode_cooling_until = #{modeCoolingUntil}, updated_at = now(3) WHERE id = #{accountId}
